title: Types of Theology
modules: Protestant Theology Unit 3 Evangelical Theology Unit 4
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any thing gained by running the difficulty further back, i. e. by supposing the watch before us to have been produced from another watch, that from a former, and so on indefinitely."
Nor is any thing gained by running the difficulty further back, i. e. by supposing the watch before us to have been produced from another watch, that from a former, and so on indefinitely.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an alternate track which is disposable."
Revelation in the Enlightenment view is an alternate track which is disposable.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the largest denominations in the world, with the members cutting across all race, gender and different social status that characterized the human society."
The Roman Catholic Church is one of the largest denominations in the world, with the members cutting across all race, gender and different social status that characterized the human society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the object of God's unqualified and out-going love (John 3:16)."
The world is the object of God's unqualified and out-going love (John 3:16).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a "realistic Christology" that deals pragmatically with problems of the now."
The Pentecostal Christology is a "realistic Christology" that deals pragmatically with problems of the now.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the offer of Godself to women and men "by means of concrete actions and symbols in history as God's self-communication to men and women" (Bevans, op.cit., p.9)."

According to this view revelation means the offer of Godself to women and men "by means of concrete actions and symbols in history as God's self-communication to men and women" (Bevans, op.cit., p.9).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a response to the socio-political segregation the Blacks have suffered in North America."
Black Theology is a response to the socio-political segregation the Blacks have suffered in North America.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the object of theology but not an object at man's disposal."
God is the object of theology but not an object at man's disposal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fastest growing movement in present day Christendom."
Pentecostalism is the fastest growing movement in present day Christendom.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an inherent dynamic of the Christian faith."
Contextualization is an inherent dynamic of the Christian faith.
fib: ______ is the self-revealing God active in his revelation.
object of God
The object of God is the self-revealing God active in his revelation.
______ is a subjective, not an objective science.
Religion
Religion is a subjective, not an objective science.
______ is the question of how to make the Gospel have more impact upon the people.
basic thrust
The basic thrust is the question of how to make the Gospel have more impact upon the people.
______ is the most basic strand upon which the other concepts are understood.
sovereignty of God
The sovereignty of God is the most basic strand upon which the other concepts are understood.
______ is the only book that is the Word of God.
Bible
The Bible - The Bible is the only book that is the Word of God.
______ is the product of theological complications arising from the encounter between Africans and the western missionary activities.
African Theology
African Theology is the product of theological complications arising from the encounter between Africans and the western missionary activities.
______ is an abandonment that is active with all our being.
Faith
Faith is an abandonment that is active with all our being.
______ is a term used to describe the process of doing theology with the aid and support of philosophical reflection, language, and methods.
Philosophical theology
Philosophical theology is a term used to describe the process of doing theology with the aid and support of philosophical reflection, language, and methods.
______ is the place and cultures-the setting of the faith that "seeks to understand." Because the settings change, the questions change.
difference
The difference is the place and cultures-the setting of the faith that "seeks to understand." Because the settings change, the questions change.
______ is a development that has been under debate as to the nature of its explication.
Contextual theology
Contextual theology is a development that has been under debate as to the nature of its explication.
